audio._why: a controlled A/B against _kinetic-cut-plain.json: the two files differ in one number and nothing else, so anything on the track would be a second variable

_why.dead-air: the frame is deliberately bare: this measures WHEN a swap happens, so anything else moving would be a second variable
_why.plain-slideshow: same reason, the swap is isolated on purpose
_why.no-continuous-object: the camera IS the thing that survives the cut here, and that is the whole point; the rule reads layers
_why.no-storyboard: a two-shot mechanism demo, not a film: the whole plan is 'one word replaces another at the frame the camera is moving fastest', and it is written down in docs/CRAFT/AE-TECHNIQUES.md #1, which names this file as its worked example
_why.static-bg: a moving backdrop would be a second thing crossing the seam, doing the hiding the camera is meant to do
